QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] The Split Star
QuestInfo.0: #p2081007# thought of something about the falling star overnight. Talk to #p2081007#. \r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2081007# says the falling star split into two before it landed on the ground. The other half fell near #m240040700#. That's where... Horntail lives! Check out if Horntail received the star's powers.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: #p2081007# said that the falling star split into two before landing on the ground and that one half fell near #m240040700#. Thankfully Horntail was unaffected by the star.\r\n
